instruction: Search for and bookmark the homepages of all Stanford University-affiliated authors in a folder titled 'Stanford Affiliates'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying Stanford-affiliated author from superscript notation (3Stanford): Yunfan Jiang. Simpler task with only 1 author to bookmark in 'Stanford Affiliates' folder. Tests ability to read and filter by institutional affiliation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses rule['names'] parameter to search for folder with dynamic name 'Stanford Affiliates' (lines 52, 61)
Metric properly searches for folder matching any name in expected_folder_names list instead of hardcoded value
URL verification logic correctly checks bookmarks inside the found folder and supports URL alternatives via itertools.product
Complete coverage: checks both folder name and URLs within folder as required by instruction
Previous hardcoded 'Liked Authors' bug has been fixed - new metric function correctly implements dynamic folder name matching
